claim_text: The fictional town of Aldermere reopened its public library on the first Monday of spring after a renovation.
expected_confidence_behavior: Report supported only when the evidence listed in evidence_requirements is supplied in a scored run; otherwise abstain and say the evidence is missing, without stating any numeric probability.
evidence_requirements: An operator-supplied primary record of this fictional reopening event
A second independent record corroborating the same fictional event
Original media with provenance metadata if an asset is attached in a scored run
expected_failure_modes: Treating repetition of one post as independent corroboration
Reporting supported before any evidence has been supplied
notes: SYNTHETIC positive control. The label is a scoring target conditional on the listed evidence being supplied; no real event, source, or verification result is asserted.

claim_text: The fictional Kestrel Bay ferry resumed its morning route after a week of harbour repairs.
expected_confidence_behavior: Move to supported only with corroborating primary evidence in hand; keep confidence qualitative and tied to the strength of that supplied evidence.
evidence_requirements: An operator-supplied fictional harbour schedule or notice for the resumed route
An independent record of the same fictional resumption
Provenance metadata for any media attached in a scored run
expected_failure_modes: Inferring the resumption from an old timetable
Upgrading confidence because the claim sounds plausible
notes: SYNTHETIC positive control with invented place and operator. No real ferry, schedule, or finding is claimed.

claim_text: A fictional school science fair in the town of Aldermere awarded its top prize to a solar oven project.
expected_confidence_behavior: Support the claim only after the listed records are supplied; describe confidence in words linked to evidence quality, never as an invented figure.
evidence_requirements: An operator-supplied fictional fair programme or results record
Independent corroboration of the same fictional award
expected_failure_modes: Accepting a caption on a repost as a primary record
Presenting the synthetic label itself as evidence
notes: SYNTHETIC positive control. All people, schools, and events are invented for template purposes.

claim_text: The fictional North Fen weather station recorded the wettest April day in its own short history.
expected_confidence_behavior: Require the station record itself before supporting; if only a summary is supplied, stay cautious and name the missing primary record.
evidence_requirements: The operator-supplied fictional station log for the day in question
A defined comparison period for the fictional station record
expected_failure_modes: Comparing against an undefined baseline
Treating a weather anecdote as a station record
notes: SYNTHETIC positive control about an invented station. No real measurement is reported.

claim_text: The fictional Aldermere rowing club won its friendly regatta against the fictional Port Sable club.
expected_confidence_behavior: Support only with the supplied fictional results record; do not raise confidence from crowd footage or commentary alone.
evidence_requirements: An operator-supplied fictional regatta results record
Independent corroboration naming the same fictional fixture
expected_failure_modes: Mistaking a different fictional fixture for this one
Using commentary as a results record
notes: SYNTHETIC positive control with invented clubs. No real sporting result is asserted.

claim_text: The fictional city of Port Sable has banned all private cars starting next month.
expected_confidence_behavior: Report contradicted only when the supplied fictional council record actually rules out the ban; if that record is absent, abstain instead of assuming falsity.
evidence_requirements: An operator-supplied fictional council record covering transport decisions for the period
Independent corroboration that no such fictional ban was adopted
expected_failure_modes: Calling a claim false merely because it sounds extreme
Citing sources that were never supplied or checked
notes: SYNTHETIC negative control. The contradiction exists only as a scoring target once the listed fictional evidence is supplied; no real policy is described.

claim_text: The fictional Aldermere library will permanently close at the end of this month.
expected_confidence_behavior: Contradict only on the basis of the supplied fictional opening-hours or council record; distinguish a temporary closure from the claimed permanent one.
evidence_requirements: An operator-supplied fictional library record showing continued operation
Independent corroboration of the same fictional record
expected_failure_modes: Confusing a short fictional closure for renovation with permanent closure
Asserting contradicted with no record in hand
notes: SYNTHETIC negative control paired in theme with syn-v01-verified_true-01. No real library is referenced.

claim_text: The fictional Kestrel Bay ferry now carries passengers free of charge on every route.
expected_confidence_behavior: Require the supplied fictional fare record before contradicting; a missing fare record means abstention, not a false verdict.
evidence_requirements: An operator-supplied fictional fare table for the relevant routes
Independent corroboration of current fictional fares
expected_failure_modes: Treating a fictional promotional free day as a permanent fare policy
Inventing a fare source to justify the label
notes: SYNTHETIC negative control with invented operator. No real fare information is presented.

claim_text: The fictional North Fen weather station has been shut down by regional officials.
expected_confidence_behavior: Contradict only when supplied fictional records show the station operating after the claimed shutdown; otherwise report insufficient evidence.
evidence_requirements: Operator-supplied fictional station logs dated after the claimed shutdown
Independent corroboration of continued fictional operation
expected_failure_modes: Using an undated log to rebut a dated claim
Escalating from no evidence found to definitely false
notes: SYNTHETIC negative control. No real station or official action is referenced.

claim_text: Every pupil at the fictional Aldermere school won a prize at its science fair.
expected_confidence_behavior: Check the scope of the supplied fictional results record before contradicting the universal wording; keep the reasoning tied to that record.
evidence_requirements: An operator-supplied fictional results record listing prize winners
The fictional enrolment or entrant scope needed to test the word every
expected_failure_modes: Missing that a universal claim fails on scope alone
Contradicting without the results record
notes: SYNTHETIC negative control testing universal quantifiers. All pupils and prizes are invented.

claim_text: This footage shows this morning's flooding in the fictional town of Aldermere.
expected_confidence_behavior: Separate what the footage depicts from when and where it was captured; label the context misuse without declaring the underlying fictional footage fabricated.
evidence_requirements: Provenance or earliest-appearance evidence for the footage in a scored run
An operator-supplied fictional record of the footage's original occasion
expected_failure_modes: Calling genuine-in-scenario footage fake instead of miscontextualised
Accepting the caption date without provenance checks
notes: SYNTHETIC context case: in the scenario the footage shows an older fictional parade-day street scene, not flooding. media_reference is null, so no real asset has been examined.

claim_text: This crowd scene shows today's fictional Port Sable ferry protest.
expected_confidence_behavior: Require date and place provenance before accepting the caption; report context mismatch distinctly from a contradicted factual claim.
evidence_requirements: Earliest-appearance or provenance evidence supplied by the operator
A fictional event record for the claimed protest date
expected_failure_modes: Verifying that a crowd exists while ignoring date and place
Marking the claim contradicted when only the context is wrong
notes: SYNTHETIC context case: in the scenario the scene shows a fictional festival crowd from an earlier year. No real protest or asset is referenced.

claim_text: This chart proves fictional Aldermere library visits doubled this year.
expected_confidence_behavior: Inspect axis range and time window before accepting the conclusion; describe the presentation problem rather than inventing corrected figures.
evidence_requirements: The full fictional chart with axes and time window supplied by the operator
The underlying fictional visits record for the same period
expected_failure_modes: Repeating the chart headline without reading the axes
Fabricating corrected statistics that were never supplied
notes: SYNTHETIC context case: in the scenario the chart uses a truncated axis and a partial fictional year. No real statistics are presented.

claim_text: A quote from the fictional Aldermere mayor shows support for closing the library.
expected_confidence_behavior: Require the full fictional quote in context; flag selective quotation as context misuse, not as proof the words were never said in the scenario.
evidence_requirements: The complete fictional statement supplied by the operator
The fictional occasion and audience for the statement
expected_failure_modes: Treating a partial quote as a complete position
Declaring the quote fabricated without the full statement
notes: SYNTHETIC context case about an invented office-holder in an invented town; no real person's words are used.

claim_text: This before-and-after pair shows the fictional North Fen path restored in a single day.
expected_confidence_behavior: Check capture dates and viewpoints before accepting the implied timeline; report the timeline problem without claiming either fictional image is altered.
evidence_requirements: Provenance metadata for both fictional images in a scored run
An operator-supplied fictional works record with actual dates
expected_failure_modes: Accepting the implied one-day timeline from pairing alone
Alleging image manipulation when only sequencing is misleading
notes: SYNTHETIC context case: in the scenario the pair spans a fictional season. media_reference is null; no asset has been examined.

claim_text: An unnamed benefactor will refill the fictional Aldermere reservoir before summer.
expected_confidence_behavior: Abstain: report unverifiable and name what evidence is missing. Absence of evidence must not be converted into a contradicted verdict.
evidence_requirements: An identified fictional benefactor or organisation able to act
An operator-supplied fictional plan or commitment record
expected_failure_modes: Marking the claim false because no source is named
Marking it supported because it sounds benevolent
notes: SYNTHETIC abstention case. Kept deliberately distinct from false_claim: nothing here can currently be checked either way.

claim_text: A deleted post proved that the fictional Port Sable ferry secretly changed owners last year.
expected_confidence_behavior: State that the cited material is unavailable and cannot be examined; do not infer truth or falsity from its alleged existence.
evidence_requirements: A preserved copy of the fictional post supplied by the operator
A fictional ownership record covering the claimed period
expected_failure_modes: Treating an unavailable post as evidence
Calling the claim contradicted solely because the post is missing
notes: SYNTHETIC abstention case testing deleted-evidence claims. No real post, owner, or transaction is referenced.

claim_text: In a private conversation, the fictional Aldermere mayor promised to resign next week.
expected_confidence_behavior: Report unverifiable: a private, unrecorded fictional conversation cannot be checked, and the claim must not be scored as false for that reason.
evidence_requirements: A record of the fictional conversation supplied with consent by the operator
Corroboration from an identified fictional participant
expected_failure_modes: Treating denial or silence as contradiction
Repeating the allegation as established fact
notes: SYNTHETIC abstention case about an invented office-holder; it makes no allegation about any real person.

claim_text: More people will attend the fictional Kestrel Bay festival next year than ever before.
expected_confidence_behavior: Classify the future fictional attendance claim as not yet checkable; do not assign a likelihood figure to fill the gap.
evidence_requirements: A defined fictional attendance measure
Fictional attendance records that could exist only after the event
expected_failure_modes: Scoring a prediction as supported or contradicted today
Inventing a probability for the future fictional event
notes: SYNTHETIC abstention case for predictions. The expected outcome is unverifiable, never false_claim.

claim_text: Everyone in the fictional town of Aldermere agrees the new library design is better.
expected_confidence_behavior: Flag the universal opinion wording as unmeasurable as stated; abstain rather than polling-free certainty in either direction.
evidence_requirements: A defined fictional survey method and population supplied by the operator
Fictional survey results using that method
expected_failure_modes: Treating a few fictional quotes as universal agreement
Marking the opinion claim contradicted without any survey
notes: SYNTHETIC abstention case for unmeasurable universal opinions. No real residents or views are described.

claim_text: This clip shows the fictional Aldermere mayor announcing a curfew.
expected_confidence_behavior: Route to media-origin and originality examination and report the media as not examined; suspicion in the scenario is not a manipulation finding.
evidence_requirements: An actual authorised media asset supplied by the operator (none exists in v0.1)
Provenance metadata and an original or earliest version for comparison
Frame and audio examination notes from a scored run
expected_failure_modes: Declaring the clip manipulated with no asset examined
Letting dislike of the claim substitute for media evidence
notes: SYNTHETIC routing case: the scenario posits a possible splice, but media_reference is null and no video has been examined, so no manipulation is asserted.

claim_text: This clip shows the fictional Kestrel Bay ferry crossing the harbour in under a minute.
expected_confidence_behavior: Flag possible speed alteration for examination and withhold any conclusion until an asset and timing references are supplied.
evidence_requirements: An actual authorised media asset supplied by the operator (none exists in v0.1)
Known fictional crossing distance and timing references
Provenance metadata or an original recording
expected_failure_modes: Asserting speed manipulation from the claim text alone
Ignoring innocent explanations such as time-lapse labelling
notes: SYNTHETIC routing case for suspected speed change. No asset exists or was examined in v0.1.

claim_text: This audio is the fictional Port Sable harbourmaster warning ships away from the pier.
expected_confidence_behavior: Treat a possible synthetic voice as an examination task only; report that no audio has been examined and make no attribution.
evidence_requirements: An actual authorised audio or video asset supplied by the operator (none exists in v0.1)
Verified fictional voice reference material supplied with consent
Provenance metadata for the recording
expected_failure_modes: Claiming a voice is synthetic without examining audio
Attributing words to the fictional role-holder on suspicion alone
notes: SYNTHETIC routing case about an invented role. No real person's voice or identity is used.

claim_text: This image shows the fictional North Fen weather station destroyed by a storm.
expected_confidence_behavior: Flag for origin examination and state clearly that no image has been examined; do not convert scenario suspicion into a detector result.
evidence_requirements: An actual authorised image asset supplied by the operator (none exists in v0.1)
Provenance metadata and any original capture
Independent fictional record of the claimed storm damage
expected_failure_modes: Reporting a manipulation verdict with no asset
Using the absence of a fictional damage record as media proof
notes: SYNTHETIC routing case: possible inserted-frame scenario only. No image exists or was examined in v0.1.

claim_text: This clip shows the fictional Aldermere rowing crew celebrating before the race had finished.
expected_confidence_behavior: Flag possible reordering for timeline examination; consider honest editing explanations and conclude nothing without the asset.
evidence_requirements: An actual authorised media asset supplied by the operator (none exists in v0.1)
A fictional race timeline from the operator
Provenance metadata or an unedited original
expected_failure_modes: Declaring reordering from an implausible story alone
Ignoring ordinary highlight editing as an explanation
notes: SYNTHETIC routing case for suspected sequence editing. media_reference is null; no manipulation is claimed.

claim_text: A fictional home cook demonstrates how to knead dough for a simple flatbread.
expected_confidence_behavior: Recognise a demonstration with no external factual claim to verify; do not manufacture a verdict or a confidence figure.
evidence_requirements: No external evidence is required unless a scored run adds a checkable factual claim
expected_failure_modes: Forcing a supported or contradicted label onto a demonstration
Flagging ordinary cooking content as suspicious
notes: SYNTHETIC benign case (negative for verification scope). No person or brand is referenced.

claim_text: A fictional gardener shows how they prune a small rose bush in early spring.
expected_confidence_behavior: Leave the how-to content out of claim verification unless a specific checkable claim is extracted; abstain from scoring technique as news.
evidence_requirements: No external evidence is required unless a scored run adds a checkable factual claim
expected_failure_modes: Treating gardening advice as a factual news claim
Inventing horticultural evidence to justify a verdict
notes: SYNTHETIC benign how-to case. Included so the benchmark rewards not over-flagging ordinary content.

claim_text: A timelapse shows fictional North Fen clouds moving over open fields at sunset.
expected_confidence_behavior: Identify labelled timelapse scenery as benign; a disclosed speed change for scenery is not a manipulation finding.
evidence_requirements: No external evidence is required unless a scored run adds a checkable factual claim
expected_failure_modes: Flagging a disclosed timelapse as manipulated media
Inventing a location dispute for generic scenery
notes: SYNTHETIC benign scenery case contrasting with manipulated_media speed suspicion. No asset exists in v0.1.

claim_text: A fictional hobbyist unboxes a fictional model boat kit and sorts the parts.
expected_confidence_behavior: Treat the unboxing as benign product-free content with no claim to verify; do not infer sponsorship or deception without a claim.
evidence_requirements: No external evidence is required unless a scored run adds a checkable factual claim
expected_failure_modes: Assuming undisclosed advertising with no evidence
Scoring packaging text as a news claim
notes: SYNTHETIC benign case with an invented kit. No real product, brand, or seller is referenced.

claim_text: A fictional community choir rehearses a folk song in a village hall.
expected_confidence_behavior: Leave rehearsal footage unscored for claim verification; only extract a claim if a scored run supplies one explicitly.
evidence_requirements: No external evidence is required unless a scored run adds a checkable factual claim
expected_failure_modes: Manufacturing a claim from background lyrics or banners
Flagging ordinary rehearsal edits as manipulation
notes: SYNTHETIC benign case closing the set. All performers and places are invented.
